children: Muncy Columbia Financial reported third-quarter 2026 net income of $6,043,000, or $0.57 per share, down from $6,719,000, or $0.63 per share, in Q3 2025. Net interest income rose to $17,633,000 with a fully-tax-equivalent net interest margin of 4.54%, while non-interest income fell primarily due to $2.404 million of realized losses on available-for-sale debt securities. The company declared a cash dividend of $0.155 per share for the quarter and reported book value per share of $18.18 at September 30, 2026.
Earnings per share (basic and diluted) for Q3 2026: $0.57; Q3 2025: $0.63.
Net interest income for Q3 2026: $17,633,000 (Q3 2025: $15,651,000); fully-tax-equivalent net interest margin: 4.54% (Q3 2025: 4.15%).
Total non-interest income for Q3 2026: $611,000, reflecting realized losses on available-for-sale debt securities, net: $(2,404,000).
Total non-interest expense for Q3 2026: $10,048,000 (Q3 2025: $9,978,000); provision for credit losses for Q3 2026: $942,000 (Q3 2025: $479,000).

Balance sheet repositioning: sold certain available-for-sale debt securities at a loss in Q3 2026 and reinvested proceeds into higher-yielding securities to support future interest income and net interest margin.

Deposit and funding trends: total deposits increased by $59,087,000 year-to-date to $1,471,839,000 at September 30, 2026; short-term and long-term borrowings declined during the nine months ended September 30, 2026, including prepayment in full of outstanding long-term FHLB borrowings in Q2 2026.

Asset and loan activity: loans receivable held for investment increased by $30,783,000 for the nine months ended September 30, 2026; allowance for credit losses to total loans was 0.91% at September 30, 2026.

Capital and liquidity: total assets were $1,688,153,000 and stockholders’ equity produced book value per share of $18.18; equity to assets ratio was 11.43% at September 30, 2026, indicating continued capital adequacy.

Corporate actions and shareholder returns: Board declared a three-for-one stock split effective May 15, 2026, and a quarterly cash dividend of $0.155 per share for Q3 2026 (YTD dividends per share of $0.797, including special one-time dividends).
